name: Calculus 1: change
description: Rates of change, limits, derivatives and a first look at integrals, taught at the Kepler outpost.
about:
Calculus 1 realm ("Calculus 1: change"): rates, limits, derivatives and the first step into integrals, for an
adult who has finished Foundations and nothing more. Same Kepler outpost, now grown: things move and flow, and
Mira is still the mentor. The concept plan is docs/CALC1-PLAN.md.

chapters.name: Rates and limits
chapters.blurb: Average rates of change, closing in on an instant, and what a limit is.

sector.name: Tracking Station
sector.purpose: follow everything that moves around the outpost

chapters.name: Continuity and infinity
chapters.blurb: Continuous functions, limits at infinity, asymptotes and trapping a root.

sector.name: Flow Control
sector.purpose: keep the pumps and pipes running without a break

chapters.name: The derivative
chapters.blurb: The derivative as a limit, tangent lines, the power rule, velocity and acceleration.

sector.name: Test Track
sector.purpose: measure how fast a rover is going at any instant

chapters.name: Rules of differentiation
chapters.blurb: Product, quotient and chain rules; sine, cosine, exponentials and logarithms.

sector.name: Machine Shop
sector.purpose: take any formula apart and find how fast it changes

chapters.name: Derivatives at work
chapters.blurb: Implicit differentiation, related rates, linear approximation and the shape of a curve.

sector.name: Launch Gantry
sector.purpose: predict how a launch will go before we light the engines

chapters.name: Best values and shortcuts
chapters.blurb: Largest and smallest values, optimisation, the Mean Value Theorem, L’Hôpital’s rule and Newton’s method.

sector.name: Design Studio
sector.purpose: find the best design instead of guessing at it

chapters.name: From change to accumulation
chapters.blurb: Antiderivatives, areas from rectangles, the definite integral and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

sector.name: Reservoir
sector.purpose: add up a changing flow into a total we can rely on

copy.homeTitle:
Nothing here stands still.
Learn to measure change.
copy.firstVisit: Welcome back. The outpost has grown: rovers drive, shuttles climb and tanks fill, and nobody can yet say how fast. We will start by timing one shuttle; everything you need you learned in Foundations.
copy.allDone: You did it. All seven stations are running, and you can say how fast anything here changes and how much it adds up to. Calculus 2 will pick up from the reservoir when it opens.
copy.chaptersNote: Seven chapters. Learn every concept in a chapter to unlock a landmark for the outpost. Practice missions are optional.

help:
WELCOME BACK

The mathematics of change.

Calculus 1 starts where Foundations ends: with slopes, functions and graphs. It teaches limits, derivatives and a first look at integrals. Every new word and symbol is explained before you are asked to use it, with a worked example first.

HOW THE OUTPOST WORKS

01 / Read the lesson and the worked example, then choose “I’m ready to try.” You can open the lesson again at any time.
02 / Answers are numbers, never formulas: a slope, a value at a point, a coefficient. Type them without commas or spaces (1250, not 1,250). Decimals such as 2.5 and fractions such as 7/6 or 1 1/2 work. When an answer must be rounded, the mission says how. Angles are in radians unless a mission says otherwise.
03 / Hints and guided steps are free and still earn the full reward. Your first solve of a mission earns XP and one skill point; every 300 XP is a level. A solve on the first check with no help also earns a ★.
04 / Missions open when the missions they build on are done. A chapter is complete when every concept in it is learned; that unlocks a landmark for the outpost, bought with skill points.
05 / Review drills ask a solved idea again with new numbers, spaced further apart each time you pass. Misses go into the error notebook at the top of the field guide.
06 / Each concept has one learn mission and up to three practice missions, marked B, C and D: the same skill in a new setting, a word problem with two or three steps, and a challenge. Practice opens when you solve the learn mission. It is optional, and it earns XP, skill points and stardust like any mission.

Progress is saved in this browser only. Use settings to export a backup or import it on another device.
